# Yumvote

> Yumvote is a family meal-planning app for iOS and Android where the whole
> household votes on dinner. Plan the week, vote on meals, and get a shopping
> list that writes itself. 480+ recipes with nutrition estimates and allergen
> labels. Free to download; Yumvote Pro adds unlimited planning and the full
> catalog with a 7-day free trial. One subscription covers the whole household.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://yumvote.app/): what Yumvote is, pricing, download links
- [Recipes](https://yumvote.app/recipes/): the full public recipe catalog
- [Privacy Policy](https://yumvote.app/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Use](https://yumvote.app/terms.html)
- [Delete account](https://yumvote.app/delete-account.html)

## Facts
- Platforms: iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play)
- Price: free; Yumvote Pro €4.99/month or €39.99/year, 7-day free trial
- One subscription covers the entire household
- Developer: Blinklabs Ltd (Malta), https://blinklabs.eu
- Support: support@yumvote.app
